qualifications: Handoff-only finite prototype. No public requests, scheduler installation, workflow edits or canonical changes have occurred during preparation.
Root must review the exact immutable plan before any live GET. An operator-supplied approval digest/time is recorded, not independently authenticated authorization.

Each later invocation needs a new named run directory and explicit invocation. This package is time-limited to the current authorized session; recurring deployment requires a separately reviewed configuration.
Only exact pinned originals are comparison baselines. Byte changes remain review-needed; no automatic baseline acceptance or legal-status migration.

At most four request events including one same-host redirect per source, four distinct targets, 2MB per source/4MB total body bytes,30seconds/request,300seconds/run. No retries, cookies, authentication, hidden routes or denial workaround.
Stop the whole batch on publisher401/403/407. Preserve earlier source results and mark unattempted sources not_checked.
Retain exact response bodies and selected public-header records only. The guard deliberately never persists cookie/auth headers; selected fields are not a complete raw HTTP header transcript.
Repository received_at is unknown at preparation. Later canonical receipt must be linked by an additive receipt instead of rewriting this frozen baseline.
Fixed URLs detect in-place byte replacements and availability changes only. New editions at different URLs, revised parent links and completed amendment chains are not monitored by this prototype.
